name: GoldZip Gold
oneLiner: XGZ is GoldZip’s one-gram physical-gold token, with issuer-described AML-gated delivery from 1,000 tokens and no title to stored bars.
collateral: Issuer-reported physical 99.99% fine gold, one gram per XGZ. The 5 October 2026 allocation snapshot maps 39,000 XGZ to 39 Heraeus 1 kg bars at Horsemart Service Limited; physical holdings are not independently verified.
pegMechanism: Ordinary AML/KYC-gated redemption starts at one 1 kg bar for 1,000 XGZ, with appointment-only collection at Horsemart Service Limited in Hong Kong. Current Rules retrieved 20 October 2026 publish a 0.25% gold-value redemption fee and US$100 application fee, but no completion deadline. The BVI terms allow operator-set exchange rates, deny proprietary rights in stored bars and pass title on collection; the prior Hong Kong-resident exclusion is no longer present in those terms. The 15 October 2026 notice offers an additional entire-balance, no-minimum USDT exit for verified self-custody Ethereum holders electing by 5 November 2026 at 23:59 UTC, with settlement within 14 Business Days after that deadline subject to lawful checks and token delivery.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XGZ is a fixed-gram operational physical-redemption claim, not a gold fund or strategy share. Ethereum block 26198051 (2026-10-15T12:55:59Z) confirms 39,000 XGZ at 8 decimals, matching the issuer's 5 October allocation CSV total. That mapping does not independently verify the bars or confer title: terms clauses 4.2-4.3 deny proprietary interest before collection. The temporary issuer-change USDT exit does not change the underlying gold reference. Insolvency safeguards remain unverified.

sources.label: GoldZip issuer change and special exit, 15 October 2026

proofOfReserves.provider: GoldZip issuer transparency publishes a 5 October 2026 holder-to-bar allocation CSV naming Horsemart Service Limited. Independent reserve reports remain coming soon; no named current attestor or independently signed reconciliation is available.

notices.title: No proprietary gold claim and BVI issuer change
notices.message: Terms deny holders proprietary interest in stored bars or cash value until physical collection, and the operator may suspend redemption. An October 15, 2026 notice named BVI GoldZip Company Limited as successor to Singapore GoldZip Pte Limited without changing the Ethereum contract.

notices.title: Concentrated supply and self-reported bars
notices.message: One address held 94.9% of XGZ supply (37,000 of 39,000 XGZ) in late October 2026. The issuer maps supply to 39 one-kilogram bars at Horsemart Service Limited, without an independent reserve audit or legal segregation proof.

notices.title: November 2026 special-exit window closed
notices.message: GoldZip's optional full-balance special exit tied to its BVI issuer transition closed on November 5, 2026, with USDT settlement scheduled within 14 business days at an issuer-selected weighted-average price and no public completion notice posted.
